plans.quote: <action>Per D-01/D-03/D-05/D-07/D-09/D-11/D-13/D-14, create the single navbar module, its Pydantic NavItem(key: str | None = None, child: str | None = None, label=None, icon=None), NavBar(viewset: str, items: list[NavItem], template: str | None = None), and cooperative CrudViewNavBarMixin.cv_navbar=None. For raw str(owner), explicit NavItem.label, and child plural labels, remove SafeData the same way but never entity-decode them: literal entity-looking input must remain literal. Keep any markup characters as text, without stripping tags or adding an HTML parser/sanitizer. Ordinary Django autoescape then escapes the normalized text exactly once in text and attribute contexts; do not force-escape the rendered default a second time. Test default template literals and interpolated values, explicit labels and owner captions with ampersands, apostrophes, literal entity sequences, safe markup and lazy translations; assert both serialized escaping and parsed visible text, with no created markup. The tag selects bar.template or theme-path tags/navbar.html and returns exactly empty output with absent/None/falsy data. First tests prove this real path, not only builder return dictionaries.
